description: This file defines React components and utility functions for rendering links, navigation, and related UI elements in a web-based test report viewer. It handles link components, URL navigation, trace linking, attachment links, and search parameter management, specifically tailored for a test report application.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Programmatically updates the browser history to navigate to a new URL and dispatches a popstate event.

methods.name: Route
methods.description: React component that renders its children if the URL search parameters satisfy a predicate.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Custom link component that handles client-side navigation through click events.

methods.name: LinkBadge
methods.description: A styled version of Link with badge-specific styles.

methods.name: ProjectLink
methods.description: Renders a link to a project, modifying search params accordingly.

methods.name: AttachmentLink
methods.description: Renders a link for a test attachment, handling content display, download, and expansion.

methods.name: TraceLink
methods.description: Renders a link to view test trace attachments.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: React hook to access current URL search parameters.

methods.name: SearchParamsProvider
methods.description: Provides URL search parameters context, updating on popstate.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Custom hook that scrolls an element into view if it is anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Checks if a given anchor ID matches current URL parameters.

methods.name: Anchor
methods.description: Component that scrolls its content into view if anchored.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Generates a URL hash string to link to a specific test and result with optional anchor.
